Smart Cache will remember previously tra: Smart Cache will remember previously transcribed sections of your media on your Mac. When you analyze the same material again with the same language and model, the extension can reuse those results instead of asking the model to repeat the whole job.
Smart Cache, lasting caption corrections: Smart Cache, lasting caption corrections, transcript search, and 100 Whisper-model languages with Auto Detect. Here is what we are preparing next.
Smart Search will let you search caption: Smart Search will let you search captions saved in your local cache. Results will show the matching text, source filename, and timecode, helping you identify a useful line without reading through every transcript.
Speech recognition requires a model to b: Speech recognition requires a model to be downloaded before use. Model downloads use an internet connection. Downloaded models and the app’s working data are stored locally. Your source media remains under your control.
Speech recognition runs locally after th: Speech recognition runs locally after the model download. No uploading your edit for transcription.
Speech recognition runs locally using Wh: Speech recognition runs locally using WhisperKit. Once your chosen model is downloaded, the transcription itself is processed on your device. You do not need to upload your footage to a cloud transcription service to generate captions.
Start and end time edits will also persi: Start and end time edits will also persist. You will be able to tighten a caption’s timing and keep that adjustment when you reopen the extension or analyze the material again. The editor checks for invalid time ranges and neighboring-caption overlaps so a small timing change does not silently create a broken sequence.

The app is free to download, with Motion: The app is free to download, with Motion templates you can install and use independently in Final Cut Pro. Automatic AI caption generation requires an active monthly subscription. Current pricing and any trial eligibility are shown in the App Store.
The app processes your project audio and: The app processes your project audio and generates transcriptions locally on your Mac. Your media and transcripts are not uploaded to a cloud AI transcription service. The app needs access to the project and media files you choose to use.
The extension returns generated titles t: The extension returns generated titles through FCPXML and groups the subtitles into a compound clip, organized in a secondary storyline. This keeps a caption pass together instead of leaving a long sequence of independent titles scattered across your main edit.
The five existing Motion templates and F: The five existing Motion templates and FCPXML handoff remain part of the experience. We are also improving how the extension fits Final Cut Pro’s saved window sizes, keeping the project drop area and template choices accessible in smaller windows.
The idea is simple. Start with your proj: The idea is simple. Start with your project’s audio, turn speech into text on your Mac, choose a title style, and bring the generated captions back into your timeline. You can spend less time building each title by hand and more time deciding how your video should feel.
The language selector will expose all 10: The language selector will expose all 100 language codes in the Whisper model catalog, together with Auto Detect. Choose a language explicitly, or let the model identify it locally as part of transcription. After the model is downloaded, transcription and language detection stay on your Mac.
The new editor will let you change capti: The new editor will let you change caption text directly inside the extension. Fix a name, adjust punctuation, or refine a phrase before generating titles. Your text corrections will be saved locally and reapplied when that cached media is used again.
The number describes model language cove: The number describes model language coverage. It does not mean we have separately tested transcription quality in every language. Accuracy still depends on the language, recording, speaker, and model, so reviewing generated captions remains part of the workflow.

These are Motion titles inside Final Cut: These are Motion titles inside Final Cut Pro, so the result belongs in the same editing environment as the rest of your project. Preview the available styles and choose the one that fits your footage before generating the final title sequence.
